fields.description: Program Description Entrance Examination 1) The entrance examination subjects includes Chinese, English and Mathematics. 2) According to the requirements students have to participate in the examination of the corresponding subjects. 3) The entrance examination is to be held in Shanghai on the last Saturday in May every year. 4) Students are not allowed to apply for majors related to their native languages. Length of Schooling: 4 years Admission only available in Fall Semester, opening in September The exact opening date is available in Acceptance Letter. Application Deadline 15th May for majors at Songjiang Campus. Completion of Program Diploma and Certificate of Bachelor\'s Degree will be issued to those who have completed the undergraduate program with qualified academic standing. Notes 1) The financial support and custody may be student\'s parents or relatives in Shanghai. 2) Tuition and any other fees are not refundable once they have been paid to SISU.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certificate of No Criminal Conviction * 2. Senior High school graduate certificate or A Level Certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Applicants, who are about to graduate, can submit a certification of upcoming graduation. * 3. Senior high school academic transcript or A Level Transcripts Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 4. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) * 5. Photocopy of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 6. Passport photo 2 recent passport-sized photo of the applicant (in size of 5cm * 4cm) 7. If you graduate from high school in China, please submit your parents’ passport. * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Chinese and Mathematics test results are required. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1) High school qualification or above, with an age between 18 to 35. Applicants who are under 18 years old as of September 1, 2026 must submit a Guardian’s Guarantee Letter (download link below). The guardian must be an adult living in China with a stable source of income. 2) In good physical and mental conditions; with reliable guardian for economic guarantee. Non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passport. 3) Following students should meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of the Ministry of Education of the PRC: (1) Students emigrate from Mainland of China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and obtain the foreign nationality; (2) Students, whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality and reside abroad, acquire foreign nationality at the time of birth. 4) Take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) test. When applying to our university, applicants must submit their CSCA test results. 5) If you studied or lived in China before, you should not have any record of violation of laws or disciplines. 6) Admission Requirements and Entrance Examinations Applicants must have Chinese proficiency of New HSK level 5. University Entrance examination include Chinese (oral test), English (oral and written tests). University Entrance examination is to be held on the last Saturday in April. For all the majors above, applicants should take CSCA Chinese and Math tests. For the following majors, applicants should also take CSCA in either Physics or Chemistry (choose one): Educational Technology, Actuarial Science, Data Science and Big Data Technology (Natural Language Processing and Financial Big Data). ★Students are not allowed to apply for their native language major.
